description: Restructure UserDashboardPage.tsx: add activeTab state, wire navbar links to tab state, add ARIA tab bar JSX, conditionally render sections as tab panels, remove the two redundant section headers, and upgrade filter chips to emoji+lg. Depends on FEAT-001 (CSS classes must exist before being referenced in JSX).
steps:
STEP 1 — Add activeTab state.
In frontend/src/pages/UserDashboardPage.tsx, after line 76 (the [searchInput, setSearchInput] state declaration), insert:

  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'events' | 'registrations'>('events');

No other state changes.

STEP 2 — Switch AppNavbar href links to onClick tab-switchers.
In UserDashboardPage.tsx, find the AppNavbar links prop (around line 452). Replace:
  { label: 'Events',           href: '#events' },
  { label: 'My Registrations', href: '#registrations' },
With:
  { label: 'Events',           onClick: () => setActiveTab('events') },
  { label: 'My Registrations', onClick: () => setActiveTab('registrations') },
Leave the Profile (to: '/profile') and Logout (onClick: handleLogout) entries unchanged. No change to AppNavbar.tsx.

acceptance_criteria: Running 'npm run build' from the frontend directory completes with exit code 0, zero TypeScript errors, zero Vite errors.
The <main> block has exactly: Alert, tab bar div (role=tablist), events conditional panel (activeTab==='events'), registrations+certs conditional fragment (activeTab==='registrations').
Both tab panel sections have full ARIA attributes: id, role=tabpanel, aria-labelledby pointing to their controlling tab button id.
Both navbar links for Events and My Registrations use onClick: () => setActiveTab(...), not href.
The 'Discover Events' header block (h3 + event-count span) is absent from the events section.
The avatar/My Dashboard/GraduationCap heading block is absent from the registrations section.
Filter chips render with emoji spans (aria-hidden=true) and have both filter-chip and filter-chip-lg classes.
Certificates IIFE is inside the registrations conditional fragment, not at the top-level of <main>.
verification: cd frontend && npm run build — expect exit code 0 and no error output.

Optionally run 'npm run dev', navigate to the student dashboard, click 'My Registrations' tab — events grid disappears and registrations list appears. Click 'Discover Events' — events grid reappears. Filter chips show emoji labels and are visibly larger than before.
findings: All 9 steps implemented in UserDashboardPage.tsx. activeTab state added; AppNavbar Events/My Registrations links converted from href to onClick tab switchers; ARIA tab bar (role=tablist, two role=tab buttons) inserted after Alert; events section wrapped in activeTab==='events' conditional div+section with id=tabpanel-events and full ARIA attrs; registrations section + certificates IIFE wrapped together in activeTab==='registrations' fragment with id=tabpanel-registrations and full ARIA attrs; Discover Events header block (h3+event-count span) removed; avatar/My Dashboard/GraduationCap heading block removed from registrations; filter chips upgraded to emoji+filter-chip-lg with aria-hidden emoji spans. Build verified: npm run build exited 0 with zero TypeScript errors and zero Vite errors (pre-existing chunk size warning only, not an error). 2616 modules transformed successfully.
